headline: Locus of Control, from entry to detail
overview: The Locus of Control assessment measures whether you tend to attribute outcomes in your life to your own actions and decisions (internal locus) or to outside forces like luck, fate, or other people (external locus). Understanding your locus of control is foundational to personal agency — it reveals how much ownership you feel over your life and where you might be giving away power you actually have.
targetAudience: Users interested in psychology tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: Research-based assessment measuring internal vs. external locus of control
Detailed score showing where you fall on the internal-external spectrum
Practical insights on how your locus of control affects your decisions and outcomes
Guidance on cultivating a healthier sense of personal agency
tips: Answer based on how you actually think, not how you wish you thought — honesty produces the most useful results
A strong external locus isn't inherently bad; it often reflects healthy acknowledgment of systemic factors
